interventions: The installed Veritas executable was not on PATH; used the current macOS ARM64 distribution path supplied by the parent task.
The installed public time interface exposes date parsing but no current-date clock, so checkout takes an explicit YYYY-MM-DD date.
The configured SQLite filename is resolved through the caller-selected writable file root; the data directory is created by the caller before launch.
failures: Resolved compiler diagnostics during initial implementation: postfix Result propagation must be bound to a local when used as a statement; TomlDocument is opaque and cannot be directly constructed; underscore match names are bindings. Final initial and follow-up checks pass.

recommendation.reason: For this local catalog, the installed native TOML and SQLite services supported configuration and persistent transactional state without a Python bridge, and the follow-up compiled into a verified relocatable package.
recommendation.observed_user_benefit: The catalog retained state across process launches, surfaced duplicate and invalid-state errors, rejected an invalid date before opening the database, and launched from the installed command with data in a separate Unicode-named caller directory. First installed list launch took 0.93 seconds.
material_regressions: Checkout requires the caller to supply its date explicitly.
The caller must create the writable data directory before launching Bookloom.
The runnable package is 12,877,276 bytes because it includes the matching Veritas runtime.

phase_measurement_basis.setup: 106 seconds from assignment start to the first source file creation.
phase_measurement_basis.build: 180 seconds from initial source creation to the first successful source check.
phase_measurement_basis.followup: 124 seconds from the due-soon source edit timestamp to completion of old/new behavior and invalid-date preservation checks.
phase_measurement_basis.installed_launch: First installed command launch measured by /usr/bin/time -p as real 0.93 seconds.

commands: veritas run --file-root <caller-data> <initial-project> add B001 <The Left Hand of Darkness>
limitations: The recommendation is based on this Veritas application trial; no independent Python baseline was built.
Checkout dates are explicit because no current-date clock is exposed in the inspected installed public time interface.
The writable data directory must already exist.
